_comment: The agent's arrange_layout templates: SINGLE SOURCE for which panels each template places. src/lib/layout-templates.ts builds each plan's panel list from this file (positions stay in TS) and services/agent_tools/catalog.py builds the arrange_layout description and pattern enum from it, so the tool never promises a panel the host does not place. Panel roles are the arrangeable panel names in layout-templates.ts (ARRANGEABLE). R15-AGENT-055.
